metadata.name: OpenLoco
metadata.summary: Open-source re-implementation of Chris Sawyer's Locomotion transport management simulation

content.value: OpenLoco is an open-source re-implementation of Chris Sawyer's Locomotion, the construction and transport management simulation video game that served as the spiritual successor to Transport Tycoon. Originally written in x86 assembly, the engine has been fully rewritten in modern C++ to improve portability, stability, and modern system compatibility.

Much like OpenTTD and OpenRCT2, OpenLoco aims to modernize classic simulation gameplay while preserving full fidelity with the original game. Please note that original game asset files (from Steam, GOG, or CD-ROM) are required to play.

items.value: Native cross-platform gameplay support on modern Linux systems
Complete modern C++ re-implementation of the classic Locomotion engine
Comprehensive transport network construction including railways, roads, trams, and airports
Compatibility with original Locomotion scenarios and save files
Ongoing improvements toward robust multiplayer networking and extended map limits
